At Yuma, AI is meaningful when it creates real value for people. As an AI Project Manager, you’ll join a collaborative team working on impactful digital solutions for leading organizations across the Benelux, working from our offices in Louvain-la-Neuve, Brussels or Leuven.

What you’ll do
...
Join a dynamic, growing and ambitious team that creates tangible value for clients in a wide range of industries, including healthcare, pharmaceuticals, mobility, energy, industry, and automotive, helping them harness the real potential of AI. As Project Manager, your work will be centered on:
...
Leading projects with a strong emphasis on the contents of AI-driven solutions (whether classical machine learning, generative AI and agentic AI).
...
Collaborating closely with AI engineers, data scientists, software developers, UX and UI designers, architects, business and functional analysts to deliver projects that are innovative and rigorous within timeline and budget.
...
Driving value by ensuring exceptional feature quality while also shaping and transforming our clients' business operations and models.

Facilitating workshops and iteration meetings with clients to distill vision into practical, value-creating deliverables.

...
Acting as a knowledge facilitator: ensuring knowledge gained in each project (AI-based, technical architecture, domain learnings) is captured, shared, and leveraged across the team.
...
Driving professional growth and motivation: coaching teams of technical and consulting talent to push boundaries while prioritizing well-being and professional development.
...
Actively contributing to B12 Consulting's management and Yuma's innovation pipeline, shaping the evolution of B12 and Yuma as well as of the next generation of content-driven AI offerings.
...
Who you are
...
You hold a Master's degree from a Business and Management school or in Engineering, Computer Science, Science, Data Science, or related disciplines or can demonstrate equivalent experience.
...
You have at least 3 years of relevant experience in project management, consulting or software development.
...
You have a strong interest in AI, IT and innovation projects and are familiar with the Agile methodology.
...
You show a strong analytic mindset, able to bridge technical and business domains, ask the right questions, and steer content-rich, high-stakes discussions.
...
You have excellent interpersonal and communication skills, able to make complexity accessible and inspire both clients and colleagues.
...
You work with a collaborative spirit and a drive to learn every day, coupled with the pragmatism and organization to deliver on commitments.
...
You speak and write fluently in English and have a working knowledge of French or Dutch.
...
Additionally, these are not mandatory but are considered assets:
...
Programming or in-depth AI/IT experience.
...
A PhD degree.
...
Clear career path, from AI Engineer to Project Manager or Technical Expert
...
Yuma is an end-to-end digital transformation group in the Benelux. AI, data, and software development are key drivers of change, but we believe there is no digital transformation without human transformation. That’s why we combine a people-centric mindset with a hands-on approach and best-in-class expertise.

Role Overview Our client, a Bay Area-based security technology company, is seeking a seasoned AI Project Manager to lead and coordinate its enterprise AI initiatives across multiple tracks. This is a pure project management role — not a developer, data scientist, or business analyst position. The ideal candidate has personally managed the delivery of an AI/LLM-based initiative (not just AI-adjacent automation) and can speak fluently and specifically to that experience. Strong executive presence, stakeholder management, and communication skills are essential, as this role requires regular engagement with senior and cross-functional stakeholders. Must-Have Qualifications (Non-Negotiable) •MUST HAVE: Direct, hands-on experience managing a project built around a Large Language Model (LLM) — Anthropic Claude experience strongly preferred — within the last 1–2 years. Candidates must be able to describe the LLM(s) used, the use case, architecture at a PM level, and measurable outcomes. •MUST HAVE: Demonstrated ownership of AI-specific project delivery (model integration, prompt/workflow design coordination, evaluation cycles, AI vendor/tooling management). General "automation" or "digital transformation" experience without AI/LLM specificity does not qualify. •MUST HAVE: Minimum 10–12 years of overall Project Management experience, including a track record of managing automation-focused programs. •MUST HAVE: Executive-level communication and articulation skills, with proven experience managing critical, senior, and sometimes difficult stakeholders across business and technical functions. Core Responsibilities •Own end-to-end delivery of the client''s AI initiatives across multiple concurrent tracks (workstreams, timelines, budgets, and dependencies). •Serve as the primary point of coordination between business stakeholders, technical/AI teams, and vendors — translating technical AI concepts into business impact and vice versa. •Define and track project plans, milestones, RAID logs, and status reporting tailored to AI/LLM project nuances (e.g., model evaluation cycles, prompt iteration, data readiness, compliance review). •Facilitate governance, steering committee updates, and executive readouts on AI program progress and risk. •Drive alignment across cross-functional teams (engineering, security, compliance, product) to keep AI tracks on schedule and within scope. •Proactively identify risks specific to AI initiatives (model performance, data privacy, third-party authentication, change management) and drive mitigation. •Manage vendor and third-party relationships tied to AI tooling and platforms. Ideal Candidate Profile •A seasoned PM (10-12+ years) who has personally sat in the driver''s seat of an AI/LLM initiative — not someone who supported one peripherally. •Comfortable being asked pointed, specific questions about their AI project experience (which LLM, what was built, how success was measured, what stakeholders were involved). •Confident, articulate communicator capable of managing up to senior/executive stakeholders and holding ground in critical conversations. •Structured, process-driven, and comfortable operating with formal PM methodology (Agile/Waterfall/hybrid) in an enterprise setting. •Prior experience in security, fintech, or other regulated/enterprise environments is a plus. What Will NOT Be Considered •Candidates whose only AI exposure is passive awareness, training, or certifications without hands-on project delivery. •Developers, analysts, data scientists, or ML engineers looking to transition into PM roles without existing PM tenure. •Generic automation/RPA project management experience with no LLM/AI component.
